hints.text: Stack the numbers so the decimal points are right on top of each other.
Tenths first: $4 + 7 = 11$ tenths, which is $1$ whole and $1$ tenth — so you carry.
$3 + 2 = 5$, plus the carried $1$ is $6$, and $1$ tenth is left: $6.1$.

explanation: Line up the decimal points so tenths sit under tenths and ones under ones.
Add the tenths: $4 + 7 = 11$ tenths. That is $1$ whole plus $1$ tenth, so write $1$ and carry the whole.
